description: This file defines a React component for a Tic Tac Toe game using Remix and Tailwind CSS. It includes initial meta information, game logic, state management, UI rendering, and styling, with functions to compute the game winner and handle user interactions.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Computes the winner of the Tic Tac Toe game based on current board state, returning the winner ('X' or 'O') and the winning line if any.
